system.description: You carry the Dusk Arcana, a deck of twelve painted trumps and one black card that is not supposed to exist. After each Long Rest, lay out your reading: draw three trumps (roll a d12 for each on the Dusk Arcana, and reroll repeats). Once per round, you can use your reaction ↻ to turn one card of your reading face down: its meaning takes effect on you or an ally you can see within 30'. A turned card is spent until your next Long Rest. Lose the deck, and you have no reading until you paint a new one in Downtime.
